rounds.text: The evidence provided strongly supports the notion that Bliss GVS Pharma Ltd (BLISSGVS) carries significant valuation risks, particularly in terms of its Return on Equity (ROE). [E27] and [E28] indicate that the median return on equity over 5 years and 3 years is only 9%, which is below the sector benchmark. This suggests that BLISSGVS may be underperforming relative to its peers, indicating potential weaknesses in its operational efficiency or profitability. Moreover, [E13] explicitly states a ROE of 8.9%, far below both the sector benchmark and the median over different time horizons. Given this evidence, it is reasonable to conclude that BLISSGVS may not be generating sufficient returns relative to its invested capital, which could lead to underperformance in the long term. Additionally, [E29] shows a ROE of 9% for the last fiscal year, still below both benchmarks and median values. This persistent underperformance suggests ongoing challenges in achieving desired profitability levels, further supporting the argument that BLISSGVS carries significant valuation risks. Conceded: [E13]
